messages.subject: simple linear regression: wide confidence interval for fitted values
parts:
Dear All,
Hi,

I fitted simple linear regression by "MLE" and "Bayes Estimator" in attached file. The confidence interval for fitted values by Bayes is very wide rather than MLE, whereas the estimated parameters by two methods are equal (almost)! I have similar problem in nonparametric regression methods. Thanks in advance.

- Bistoon

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] simple linear regression: wide confidence interval for fitted values
parts:
You mean the Bayesian posterior interval is wider than
some confidence interval? Are you using a 95% Bayesian
posterior and a 2 standard-deviation confidence interval?

Do you have reason to believe the posterior interval
isn't being computed correctly? You have very wide priors
on both the variance and the coefficients; we strongly recommend
against those priors, with alternatives recommended in our
manual regression chapter and here:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/wiki/Prior-Choice-Recommendations

- Bob
